title: The Vault Where Inversions Learn to Echo

features.name: inverted mirror
features.desc-on-touch: The glass shows you backwards, but also shows the backwards chamber behind it. The inversion reflects, and then reflects back, until the room becomes a hall of doubles.

features.name: reversed footprint path
features.desc-on-touch: The road beneath your feet runs backwards into itself. Each step echoes a step you have not taken yet.

features.name: echo-learning arch
features.desc-on-touch: Sound arrives here inverted, then returns corrected, then inverts again. The arch has learned to repeat itself in every possible order.

features.name: inverted tree reflection
features.desc-on-touch: The tree hangs from its roots into the chamber floor. You cannot tell if it is growing downward or the chamber is inverted around it.

features.name: time pool reflection
features.desc-on-touch: The pool mirrors forward and backward simultaneously. You see yourself arriving and departing at once.

features.name: inverted gateway stack
features.desc-on-touch: Stones stacked in a way that reads the same upside down. The gateway leads both in and out.

inscription: what is reflected here learns to reflect itself; inversion becomes an echo of its own reversal
